subject: Request: ephemeral credential sampling + merge approval timestamp exports
messages:
From: Alice Martin <alice@bluewatersec.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liao <tom.liao@fin-assess.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — ephemeral credential rotation samples + merge approval timestamps
Attachments: (none yet)

Hi Karthik,

Bluewater is working through the PacificTrust SIG intake and we need a compact evidence package focused on runtime secrets and merge authorization provenance. Specifically can you provide:

- A sampling (CSV or export) of ephemeral credential leases issued in Q4 2025 — include lease start/end timestamps, requester id, and scope (runner/container id).
- Extract of merge approvals for main/release branches for changes that touched serving/runtime or CI config (commit id, approver, approval timestamp).
- Branch protection policy and any boolean flags (required reviews, enforce admin, status checks).
- Notes on how branch protection interacts with your CI runner ephemeral credentials (short text is fine).

We understand some items will need redaction; please indicate which fields are redacted and why. Target for our review is end of week (Friday 20 Mar). If you can confirm scope and ETA I will map it into the intake.

Thanks,
Alice Martin
Senior Assessor, Bluewater Security
alice@bluewatersec.com

On behalf of: PacificTrust Bank assessment team

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martin <alice@bluewatersec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — ephemeral credential rotation samples + merge approval timestamps
Attachments: branch-protection-policy-2026-03.pdf; merge-approval-extract-202603.jsonl

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can provide the exports you requested. Quick clarifications:

- For ephemeral credential leases we will export a Q4 2025 sample (we have lease events stored in our secrets service). We will redact host/internal runner hostnames but will keep runner IDs and timestamps.
- Merge approvals: we will pull approvals for main and release branches for repos matching "redwood-serving" and "infra/ci-config". The extract will include commit SHA, PR number, approver email, and approval timestamp. We will not include full PR bodies in the export.
- Branch protection policy attached (PDF) is the canonical policy enforced by Git provider.
- Short note on interaction: our CI runner obtains short-lived tokens via the secrets service; tokens are issued per-runner with 1–15 minute leases depending on job class. The branch protection gate requires required reviewers and passing status checks tied to a specific runner set.

ETA: I will circulate the first bundle by EOD Wed 18 Mar, and the supporting logs (CI rotation log) by Thu 19 Mar. If that schedule works for PacificTrust please ping and I will prioritize.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martin <alice@bluewatersec.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — ephemeral credential rotation samples + merge approval timestamps
Attachments: ci-runner-rotation-202602.log; secret-lease-sampling-202602.csv

Hi Alice,

Following up with the artifacts Karthik referenced. Attached are:

1) secret-lease-sampling-202602.csv — a Q4 2025 sampling exported from our secrets ledger. Columns: lease_id, runner_id (redacted host portion), requester_principal, scope_tags, lease_start_utc, lease_end_utc, redaction_notes. We redacted hostnames ("REDACTED_HOST") and any internal IPs per our data minimization policy.

2) merge-approval-extract-202603.jsonl — exported approvals for main/release branches across target repos. Each line is a minimal JSONL record: {"repo","pr","commit","approver","approval_ts"}. (We included the JSONL in the thread attachments bundle.)

3) ci-runner-rotation-202602.log — succinct runtime log showing token rotations for the ephemeral runner pool (timestamps and opaque token IDs). Token IDs are hashed; full tokens are never exported.

Notes:
- Our secrets service uses short-lived leases issued from the KMS-backed vault; rotation events are recorded in the ledger and retention is 90 days for audit exports.
- Branch-protection-policy-2026-03.pdf (attached by Karthik) documents required checks.

If you need a redaction mapping table or narrower time window we can regenerate.

--
Irene Choi
Principal, DevSecOps
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Alice Martin <alice@bluewatersec.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Liao <tom.liao@fin-assess.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — ephemeral credential rotation samples + merge approval timestamps
Attachments: (none)

Karthik / Irene,

Received — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. The sampling looks good; the redaction approach (host redaction + hashed token ids) is acceptable for our audit. Two small follow-ups:

- Can you add a one-line mapping for the "requester_principal" values to role (engineer/team) where possible (redacted where necessary)? Even a CSV with principal -> role is sufficient.
- For the merge approvals extract, please confirm whether "approver" is always a human account or if bot/service accounts occasionally auto-approve status checks. If bots are present, flag them in the export.

Target: we plan to ingest the artifacts into our evidence repo by Thu 19 Mar; can you provide the mapping + approver flags by Wed EOD? If so we'll close this intake.

Best,
Alice Martin
Senior Assessor, Bluewater Security

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Martin <alice@bluewatersec.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — ephemeral credential rotation samples + merge approval timestamps
Attachments: requester-principal-to-role-202603.csv

Acknowledged — we will provide the principal->role mapping and annotate any approvers that are non-human. Irene: I will route a filtered approvals extract through the privacy review and send the CSV by Wed EOD as requested.

Thanks,
Karthik
